chunks: Surely the ledger of the pious will be in 'Illiyun (heights above the heights).

key_terms.الْأَبْرَارِ: The pious or righteous ones, plural of barri
key_terms.عِلِّيِّينَ: A high station in Paradise, often translated as 'heights above the heights'
key_terms.كِتَابَ: The book or ledger of deeds

ai.seo_question: Where is the book of the righteous placed according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Illiyun is often interpreted not merely as a physical location but as a spiritual station of proximity to Allah, reserved for the righteous who attained spiritual purity. This verse highlights the ultimate reward for those who fulfilled their covenant with God, contrasting their elevated status with the fate of the wicked whose record is kept in 'Sijjin'. The term 'al-abrar' specifically denotes the pious who consistently perform good deeds, reflecting the Shia emphasis on both faith and righteous action.
